spec.description: Deterministic NOC incident workflow. The original AI dashboard remains available as an unchanged fallback.

spec.title: Active Events
spec.description: Current non-interface incidents; active state is never hidden by the dashboard time range.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(device, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS device,
        argMax(entity_name, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_name,
        argMax(entity_type, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_type,
        argMax(event_family, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS event_family,
        argMax(protocol, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS protocol,
        argMax(lifecycle_status, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS lifecycle_status,
        argMax(severity, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS severity,
        argMax(first_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS first_seen,
        argMax(last_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_seen,
        argMax(resolved_at, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS resolved_at,
        argMax(occurrence_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS occurrence_count,
        argMax(state_change_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS state_change_count,
        argMax(last_observation_state, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_observation_state,
        argMax(interface_flap, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS interface_flap,
        argMax(title, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS title,
        argMax(body, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS deterministic_detail
    FROM observability.incident_updates
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT count() AS "Active Events"
FROM latest
WHERE lifecycle_status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'OPEN', 'RECOVERING')
  AND entity_type != 'interface'

spec.title: Active Events
spec.description: One current row per unresolved non-interface incident. Event Details uses the latest AI summary when available and deterministic state detail otherwise. Search is server-side and the time picker does not hide persistent incidents.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(device, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS device,
        argMax(entity_name, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_name,
        argMax(entity_type, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_type,
        argMax(event_family, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS event_family,
        argMax(protocol, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS protocol,
        argMax(lifecycle_status, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS lifecycle_status,
        argMax(severity, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS severity,
        argMax(first_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS first_seen,
        argMax(last_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_seen,
        argMax(resolved_at, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS resolved_at,
        argMax(occurrence_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS occurrence_count,
        argMax(state_change_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS state_change_count,
        argMax(last_observation_state, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_observation_state,
        argMax(interface_flap, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS interface_flap,
        argMax(title, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS title,
        argMax(body, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS deterministic_detail
    FROM observability.incident_updates
    GROUP BY incident_id
),
latest_ai AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(body, tuple(timestamp, run_id)) AS ai_description
    FROM observability.ai_updates
    WHERE notEmpty(incident_id) AND notEmpty(body)
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT
    severity AS "Severity",
    device AS "Device",
    title AS "Event",
    if(
        notEmpty(ifNull(ai_description, '')),
        ai_description,
        concat(
            'Detected ', event_family, ' event',
            if(empty(entity_name), '', concat(' involving ', entity_name)),
            if(
                empty(last_observation_state),
                '.',
                concat('; current observed state: ', last_observation_state, '.')
            )
        )
    ) AS "Event Details",
    lifecycle_status AS "State",
    first_seen AS "First Seen",
    last_seen AS "Last Activity",
    dateDiff('minute', first_seen, now()) AS "Age (min)",
    occurrence_count AS "Occurrences",
    event_family AS "Category",
    incident_id AS "Incident ID"
FROM latest
LEFT JOIN latest_ai USING incident_id
WHERE lifecycle_status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'OPEN', 'RECOVERING')
  AND entity_type != 'interface'
  AND (${severity_filter:sqlstring} = 'all' OR lowerUTF8(severity) = ${severity_filter:sqlstring})
  AND (${active_search:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(concat(device, ' ', entity_name, ' ', event_family, ' ', protocol, ' ', title, ' ', deterministic_detail, ' ', ifNull(ai_description, ''), ' ', incident_id), ${active_search:sqlstring}) > 0)
ORDER BY multiIf(severity IN ('emergency', 'alert'), 0, severity = 'critical', 1, severity = 'error', 2, severity = 'warning', 3, 4), last_seen DESC
LIMIT 500

spec.title: Interface Flaps
spec.description: Every unresolved interface incident is kept here, including its first down observation; recovery moves it to Resolved after the quiet-period gate.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(device, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS device,
        argMax(entity_name, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_name,
        argMax(entity_type, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_type,
        argMax(event_family, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS event_family,
        argMax(protocol, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS protocol,
        argMax(lifecycle_status, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS lifecycle_status,
        argMax(severity, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS severity,
        argMax(first_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS first_seen,
        argMax(last_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_seen,
        argMax(resolved_at, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS resolved_at,
        argMax(occurrence_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS occurrence_count,
        argMax(state_change_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS state_change_count,
        argMax(last_observation_state, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_observation_state,
        argMax(interface_flap, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS interface_flap,
        argMax(title, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS title,
        argMax(body, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS deterministic_detail
    FROM observability.incident_updates
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT
    device AS "Device",
    entity_name AS "Interface",
    last_observation_state AS "Current State",
    lifecycle_status AS "State",
    first_seen AS "First Seen",
    last_seen AS "Last Activity",
    state_change_count AS "Flaps",
    occurrence_count AS "Occurrences",
    dateDiff('minute', first_seen, now()) AS "Age (min)",
    incident_id AS "Incident ID"
FROM latest
WHERE lifecycle_status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'OPEN', 'RECOVERING')
  AND entity_type = 'interface'
  AND (${flap_search:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(concat(device, ' ', entity_name, ' ', event_family, ' ', protocol, ' ', title, ' ', incident_id), ${flap_search:sqlstring}) > 0)
ORDER BY last_seen DESC, state_change_count DESC
LIMIT 500

spec.title: Resolved Events
spec.description: Resolved incident episodes in the selected time range. Records remain searchable history and are not deleted by dashboard actions.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        argMax(device, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS device,
        argMax(entity_name, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_name,
        argMax(entity_type, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS entity_type,
        argMax(event_family, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS event_family,
        argMax(protocol, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS protocol,
        argMax(lifecycle_status, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS lifecycle_status,
        argMax(severity, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS severity,
        argMax(first_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS first_seen,
        argMax(last_seen, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_seen,
        argMax(resolved_at, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS resolved_at,
        argMax(occurrence_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS occurrence_count,
        argMax(state_change_count, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS state_change_count,
        argMax(last_observation_state, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS last_observation_state,
        argMax(interface_flap, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS interface_flap,
        argMax(title, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS title,
        argMax(body, tuple(snapshot_version, snapshot_id)) AS deterministic_detail
    FROM observability.incident_updates
    GROUP BY incident_id
)
SELECT
    severity AS "Severity",
    device AS "Device",
    title AS "Event",
    lifecycle_status AS "Resolution",
    first_seen AS "First Seen",
    resolved_at AS "Resolved",
    dateDiff('minute', first_seen, assumeNotNull(resolved_at)) AS "Duration (min)",
    occurrence_count AS "Occurrences",
    event_family AS "Category",
    if(entity_type = 'interface', 'yes', 'no') AS "Interface Flap",
    incident_id AS "Incident ID"
FROM latest
WHERE lifecycle_status = 'RESOLVED'
  AND resolved_at >= $__fromTime
  AND resolved_at <= $__toTime
  AND (${severity_filter:sqlstring} = 'all' OR lowerUTF8(severity) = ${severity_filter:sqlstring})
  AND (${resolved_search:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(concat(device, ' ', entity_name, ' ', event_family, ' ', protocol, ' ', title, ' ', incident_id), ${resolved_search:sqlstring}) > 0)
ORDER BY resolved_at DESC
LIMIT 500
